# Topics

This folder groups the core themes and analytical categories used to evaluate ADHD assessment, treatment, and systemic oversight in Denmark. It covers clinical performance metrics, demographic patient flows, educational outcomes, and regional disparities, alongside the policy frameworks, governance structures, and standardized processes that shape national psychiatric care. Together, these areas synthesize the data quality, compliance shortfalls, and strategic developments tracked by the Danish ADHD-DATABASEN and its governing bodies.

## Pages

- [[topics/data-quality/index|Data Quality]] — Examines systemic flaws and incomplete registration practices in the ADHD-DATABASEN, including missing demographics and unrecorded treatments.
- [[topics/demographic/index|Demographic]] — Tracks patient flows, gender distributions, and regional variations across the ADHD assessment and treatment populations in Denmark.
- [[topics/educational-outcome/index|Educational Outcome]] — Details the disparity in primary school leaving exam pass rates between youths with ADHD and the general background population.
- [[topics/governance/index|Governance]] — Details the steering committee's oversight of ADHD quality indicators, including operational adjustments and potential metric reclassifications.
- [[topics/indicators/index|Indicators]] — Documents specific quality metrics like Indikator 7a+7b, tracking educational milestones and regional feedback on systemic challenges.
- [[topics/low-performance/index|Low Performance]] — Identifies departments falling below established operational thresholds, such as the 20% benchmark in ADHD reporting.
- [[topics/non-compliance/index|Non Compliance]] — Highlights systemic failures to meet clinical standards, including zero compliance for specific indicators and missing private sector registrations.
- [[topics/outlier-performance/index|Outlier Performance]] — Identifies psychiatric departments achieving exceptionally high results, specifically those exceeding the 80% threshold in clinical metrics.
- [[topics/performance/index|Performance]] — Evaluates national and regional fulfillment of 11 ADHD quality indicators, highlighting systemic shortfalls in timeline adherence and adult care.
- [[topics/performance-change/index|Performance Change]] — Analyzes year-over-year regional improvements in ADHD care metrics, highlighting significant gains in Midtjylland and Syddanmark.
- [[topics/policy/index|Policy]] — The overarching policy framework for ADHD treatment quality, detailing the Styregruppen's management of clinical indicators and national strategies.
- [[topics/policy-change/index|Policy Change]] — Details recent structural adjustments to ADHD clinical indicators, including the splitting and redefinition of specific metrics.
- [[topics/policy-development/index|Policy Development]] — Details anticipated improvements to performance metrics based on upcoming guidelines for non-pharmacological ADHD treatment.
- [[topics/processes/index|Processes]] — Covers core clinical workflows like the standardized diagnostic assessment, the 9-hour treatment framework, and cross-sectoral network meetings.
- [[topics/quality-indicator/index|Quality Indicator]] — Outlines metrics used to measure diagnostic timeliness and track prevailing treatment modalities within hospital-based psychiatry.
- [[topics/quality-indicators/index|Quality Indicators]] — Catalogs the complete set of national clinical quality indicators managed by the Danish ADHD-DATABASEN to monitor process adherence.
- [[topics/quality-standard/index|Quality Standard]] — Outlines the 90% compliance targets for ADHD diagnostic and treatment indicators and the regulatory frameworks enforcing them.
- [[topics/regional-variation/index|Regional Variation]] — Analyzes geographic disparities in clinical indicators, educational outcomes, and patient pathway volumes across Denmark's five healthcare regions.
